batting.name: N Rana
batting.dismissal: c SO Hetmyer b YS Chahal

batting.name: AD Russell
batting.dismissal: c R Ashwin b KM Asif

batting.name: SP Narine
batting.dismissal: c JE Root b Sandeep Sharma

balls.text: Overpitched just outside off, Narine launches an off-drive and is unable to clear Root at long-off. It's a bread-basket catch taken with ease
Roy goes onto off stump, Sandeep goes across and tries to slap the wide yorker. Falls over and gets the ball to long-off
Full around off, tries to whack it over midwicket. Goes off the bottom to deep midwicket. Whistles along the ground, straight towards the fielder again

Appeal for caught behind, umpires have a chat and go upstairs to check if it landed in front of the keeper. It was an in-between length ball that landed outside off and straightened a bit. Narine tried to flap it over long-on and got an underedge. Samson bent to the right and his gloves were close to the ground, the ball seems to have landed on the grass into the gloves. The third umpire just has a couple of angles, both front-on, but says it definitely has landed.
Sandeep goes for the yorker around seventh, the 124kph lands on point and Narine opens the face and drills out a square drive, it hovers low before squeezing through in the gap behind point
Full around off, whacked to long-on. Bat turns in the hand and the ball rolls along the ground
Cuts hard but swings himself off position and the ball rolls along towards long-off due to the limited timing
Full on leg, whipped along the ground to deep midwicket. Pace: 88kph, he slowed it down there

The dots build and he tries to go over long-off but finds Root there. Chahal is punching the air again. It was a full ball on off, Rinku charged and went for the slash over extra but couldn't find the timing there. A few commenters asking why Chahal's on and he's done brilliantly so far
RInku shapes to charge but sees the shortish ball outside off and goes still, cuts off the middle but finds point
Rinku goes to launch a reverse sweep but gets beaten by the full ball outside off
Smashed down the ground, hits the stumps at the other end and goes to long-off. It was a full ball outside off
Wide and full, Rinku lunges and drives to the right of long-off. Quick running allows two
Back of length outside off, Rinku sees it early, waits and mows it wide of long-on for a 77-metre six
Yorker at sixth stump is dug out with a jam of the bat on the ground. Goes to point. Pace: 129kph
Bouncer outside off, Rinku shapes to play it before letting it go

Caught-behind appeal turned down, no review. Yorker outside off, Rinku planted his front leg across to go leg side but changed his bat, jammed the full-faced stick to guide it towards third. Missed it
Goes on one knee and tries the sweep. The length ball takes the bottom of the bat and trickles to deep backward square
Full ball is nudged to midwicket, Samson tells Chahal he needs to run after it, which he does but deep midwicket came in and stopped it
Googly beats the outside edge. Fullish ball pitches around off and goes away, Anukul opens the face and searches for the ball, hands follow but bat doesn't make contact with ball

LBW appeal turned down, Chahal's signalling the T. Samson calls for the review later. Thakur misses the sweep there and got hit just under the knee-roll of the bent front foot. It was a full ball that hit him right in front. No edge. Was it bouncing over? No, it's hitting middle and top, three reds and Thakur has to go.
Full on off at 90kph, pushed to deep cover
Yes and no from the batters but they complete a quick single to catching cover, running in. It was a full ball that was defended gently

Chahal goes wide, Iyer chases and skies it to Boult, who takes a tumbling catch at cover. It was a full slider at 92kph just inside the tramline and Iyer stayed in his crease and tried to go over cover. It hit wide and high on the bat. Chahal has two

Two more saved in the field, this time by Boult, who runs to the right from deep square and dives. Hetmyer runs in from the other end and throws to the keeper. It was a full ball that Rinku whipped across, it went off the bottom of the bat but was hurtling along the grass
Wide full toss, the 139kph ball goes past Rinku's attempted steer with a fully open bat face. To the keeper on the bounce
Back of length outside off, square driven to deep point

Thumped over Root's head at long-on. It was a length ball into the pitch, just outside off. It was a bit low for the pull but Iyer kind of sliced it up in the air and managed to saucer it 79 metres far
Slower one, Rinku's too early on the cover drive. Ball pops up high but lands in the gap wide of cover. Deep point comes in and stops it.
Goes across and tries to paddle the low, wide full toss. Inside edge takes the ball onto pad and trickles to the leg side. Iyer brings up fifty there
Works a length ball around off to long-on
Flicked, Buttler slides to the left and saves two. Iyer charged the fullish ball there and flicked it, timed it well. Buttler went from long-on
Fullish ball on length is helped to short fine leg
Length on leg, clipped back to the bowler
Leading edge off the gentle flick takes it to backward point. It popped in the air for a bit. The ball is holding in the pitch now. That was on a back of length, came in around leg
Full at the stumps at 96kph, flicked to deep midwicket
Upper cut is uppish but falls safely. On the bounce to deep third
Full just outside off, Iyer tries to bash the slower one but the flick goes off the bottom of the bat. Along the ground to long-on
Length outside off, steered to deep point

Cut on the move, Ashwin takes a catch just over the head at backward point. Russell was on the move and was cramped by the hard-length ball angling in. He went through with the cut but got it off the edge. Ashwin's alert as ever, Asif is pumped as Russell walks back. The change of length works for Asif

Too full and Russell goes Carlos Brathwaite mode as he whacks it over long-off. The front leg was out the way, the slot ball was on off stump, Russell swiped and it went 83 metres far. Maximum height: 37 metres. Samson went to the bowler right after the hit for a chat.
Length outside out, driven to deep cover
Legbreak just misses off stump. It was a length ball that pitched around middle and off and spun away. Russell was on one knee and went for the slog sweep. Ball went below the bat
Full just outside off, driven to deep cover's right. KKR's 100 is up
Bottom hand comes off as Iyer goes inside out over cover. It was full and slow on middle, Iyer made room and cleared the in-field.
Almost a drag on, the sweep from the full ball outside off takes the inside edge. Goes past leg stump, to short fine leg
Pulls the shortish ball in the gap to the right of deep square leg

Long six down the ground, Buttler and Root at long-on and off were interested for a bit but the 78-metre six cleared them. It was a wide ball on a length, Iyer got close-ish to the pitch and slashed across, got it close to the toe but also had enough power
Pretty much a replay of the last ball, it was around off.
Russell winds down while taking guard and ducks again to go under the bouncer that arrowed towards him
Down the pitch, the shortish ball at 135kph is cut into the ground with limited timing and the lower-half of the horizontal bat. Goes to long-off
Full toss slips out, it's away from the tramline. Left alone
Russell's well wide of leg stump as he tries to heave the slower ball across the line, it's off the bottom of the bat. Goes to long-on

More brilliant fielding from Sandeep, who races across to the right from deep third. He grabs and pushes the ball to deep-backward point who was running in from the other side. It was a length ball that was slashed off the outside edge
Short ball is spotted early but Iyer mistimes the pull. It goes in the air but lands in the empty space behind square

Pulled, Jurel runs to the right at deep midwicket, manages to pluck it with his right hand. He got hold of the ball while standing, did well to get up and throw it in one move. It was a shortish ball that was pulled.
Length outside off, dabbed to point
Full outside off, tossed up invitingly again. Pushed to the bowler's right. Samuel Badree calls it seductive bowling
LBW appeal fizzles out as the googly was spinning in too far. It was a full ball that beat the defence aimed towards mid-on

Swept flat in the air, Shimron lunges down and takes it at deep-backward square. Chahal is now the highest wicket-taker in the IPL. Chahal upper cuts the air in celebration. He got there with a legbreak spinning a bit towards off stump, Rana got on one knee and hit it decently but the placement was off. Didn't look like Hetmyer spotted it at first but managed to go down and take it.
Googly it is on a length, it's wide and is chopped off the bottom of the bat to point
Nitish slaps the wide ball wide of long-off to make it 18 for the over. It was on a length, Rana waited for it and swiped across, raced to the fence
Yorker on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Flat on a length outside off, cut to backward point

Down the track, launched inside out over extra. Bat goes high in follow-through. He got to the pitch of the ball that pitched just inside the tramline, his back leg sprung up as he hit the 93-metre six

Iyer finally connects with the hard, flat sweep. It was length around eighth stump, he's been in that position, taking a step across, towards the line, and trying to mow it. He finally does it, gets it wide of deep midwicket and goes, 'yes!'
Length on off, pulled to deep midwicket
Length just outside off, guided to point
Full and wide, slapped along the ground to the right of long-off, who does well to slide and stop
Quicker shortish ball is pulled behind square, to the deep
Length outside off, Rana tries to tap it into the ground with a horizontal bat. Ball goes back into the crease and to the keeper. Not too far from the stumps
First four in 29 balls comes via Rana's glove, he tried to sweep the length ball angling into the pad. Got it fine, the keeper and short fine leg had no chance
Makes room and slaps the length ball to deep point
Iyer's standing well outside leg, gets a length ball around sixth stump. Drags it across with a sweep, decent timing but it goes along the ground, straight to midwicket
Length outside off, opens the face to pat it towards point
Ashwin goes wide, Iyer stays in his crease for a change and tries to slap it. Uses the room well but the timing isn't as good, gets it to deep point
Length around off at 98ks again, flicked to deep midwicket again
Down the track, tries to whip it on the move. The back-of-length ball is hit along the ground to deep-mid
Length outside off, cut to deep point. Pace: 98kph
Length outside off, cut to deep third. Root bowled with a bit of a sidearm action that over, it brought the ball in, sharply with the angle
Iyer makes early room again and misses the hard sweep again. Delfects off the pad to short fine
Rana tries to shovel the length ball on the pads, goes off the edge to short fine
Length ball on the pads of Iyer, charging down, flicked away behind square to the deep
Whippy flick off the back foot on leg takes the back of length ball to deep midwicket
Length ball on middle and off at 92kph, flicked to deep midwicket
Length outside off, chopped to point. Smart bowling from Ashwin, he reacted to Iyer's early movements really well.
Iyer makes ample room again, tries to slog sweep and misses. The length ball doesn't miss leg stump by much
Iyer takes a step out with his back leg before coming back. Works against him as he gets a full ball on middle and can't capitalise. Pushed to cover with limited timing
Full on middle and off, nudged to midwicket
Iyer makes room well before the release, Ashwin foes flat on a length. The 98kph ball is swept to deep square leg
Length outside off, chopped to point. That came straight, no spin
Iyer makes room and Boult follows with a full ball. Beats the bat and deflects off the pad behind square
Length around off, blocked in front

Throw at the striker's end from point misses the stumps and there's no fielder in the ring backing up, KM Asif has to run from deep fine leg to the right, puts in a dive and the batters run three. It was a length ball outside off patted to the right of Jaiswal at point
Full on middle and off, flicked along square. Deep fine leg runs to the right and stops it
Fullish ball outside off, pushed to mid-off

Ripper taken by Sandeep at mid-off and Gurbaz has his bat on his head. It was a full ball that Gurbaz made room to and tried to thump over mid-off, it went flat and to the right of Sandeep, who tumbled and took it mid-air. Even Boult went 'wow' at that.
Yorker on middle and leg, Gurbaz slides his back foot to the left to make space for the off-drive. Mid-off runs to the right to keep it to one
Length on middle at 133kph, punched defensively to the right of cover
Gurbaz backs away and Sandeep sees him, bowls a knuckle ball into the pitch. It's on top of off and is driven off the back foot, with a bit of a check, to cover
Slower one into the pitch, it's on top of middle and is clipped to midwicket
Inside out over extra, Sandeep looks for swing but it comes straight on towards middle and off. Gurbaz stayed leg side of the ball, stood still and held his pose. It's a 78-metre six
Gurbaz uses the crease instead of charging, he was in perfect position for the in-between length ball coming in towards off stump, slapped it over mid-off
Slight leading edge off the flick but it's played with soft hands, that takes the ball along the ground towards mid-off. It was a full ball darting in at the stumps
Fullish ball comes in to middle and leg at 137kph, Iyer's front leg clears to adjust for the swing. It's flicked to midwicket
Venky charges and tries to whack a cover drive but the length ball around fifth is out of his reach. Swings away as it approached the keeper
Length outside off, steered to short third

Hetmyer runs to the right from deep square leg, his hands are flailing after he runs across with the momentum taking him forward, but he manages to cling on. It was a length ball that was a cutter on a fullish length that Roy tried to help along. The flick was played on the move and that was how the catch was taken as well.
Roy picks the line, uses the width and slaps the length ball over midwicket. Clears the infield and that was all that was needed
Slow and full on middle, Gurbaz clips it to midwicket
Slightly back of length outside off, guides it with an angled bat to backward point
Length outside off, Gurbaz slashes. Thick outside edge goes to the right of the diving short-third fielder. Four

Confident appeal for caught behind from RR, Samson and Sandeep have a chat. RR review. Gurbaz went down the track and tried to mow the length ball over long-on. The inswinger curved in a bit and it looks like it's gone past the inside edge. UltraEdge confirms it has, it brushed the pad on the way. Third umpire says no need for ball tracking as it was clearly going down leg
Slight miscommunication in running but Roy goes back after taking off, and there's no direct hit from the underarm throw. It was a length ball that was clipped to midwicket
Length outside off, patted off the back foot to point. Pace: 126kph
Roy gets squared up the length ball angling away past fifth stump. He decided late to try and dab it to third but ended up playing all around it and missed it
Roy misses the flick and is hit on the pad by the full ball, it goes towards square leg
Squeezes a yorker on fifth stump between backward point and point. Roy's figured out it isn't swinging, so he's waiting for the ball to arrive and not overhit it
Boult tries to hit a length. Bowls at 137kph at the stumps and Roy clips it to midwicket
Slightly fuller but similar ball and Roy goes for the cover drive again. Doesn't middle it but it's better than last ball. Goes to mid-off
Roy's waiting for the full ball to swing, it doesn't and that means the cover drive is uppish. Luckily for Roy, it goes in the gap to the right of cover. Stopped in the outfield

Low full toss is flicked along the ground behind square. It's in the gap for four. Jaiswal points to the logo, looks up and raises his bat, takes a bow and opens his arms wide to choreograph a celebration

Yes, it was full and going down leg. He ensured his front leg followed the ball and blocked it in front. Skipper came down, put both his hands up and seemed to have said, 'chakka maar' (hit it for a six) if my lip reading was right
Another leading edge, Jaiswal tried to flick the ball gently but got it along the ground to deep point
Beaten. Googly landed on a full length outside off and turned away sharply. Jaiswal tried to clip it across but got beaten on the leading edge. He nods to acknowledge the excellence of that ball
Another reverse sweep connects, it's over deep third and Jaiswal gets into the 90s. He got it on a full length and hit it one bounce-four
Flicks the length ball to deep midwicket

Gurbaz misses a tough stumping chance. Jaiswal charged and tried to slap the length ball over long-off but he was going down and the ball, around fifth stump, was outside his reach. It kept low too and hit the keeper's pad, he hadn't moved his glove up to that point
Length on off at 95kph, defended in front of point for a quick single
Jaiswal lunges across, goes on one knee and is uncertain for a moment. He goes for the cut but is too late
Punches the length ball from top of the stumps to long-off
Makes room and pulls the short ball over midwicket. He was making room and Varun tried following him, but that sat up at rib-height and Samson slapped it 94 metres far
Length outside off, clipped to long-on
Sweeps the length ball from outside off, finds the gap to the right of deep square leg, who was racing across. Century of the partnership is up
Pumped over long-on. Samson was standing on off stump, Roy went full on middle. Samson cleared the front leg and hit it through the line
Overpitched on fourth stump, lumps it down the ground. He stayed leg side and hit it 83 metres far
Dragged down leg, Jaiswal crouches and pulls it along the ground to deep fine leg
Charges and pads the full ball back to the bowler. Roy saw him coming and angled it into his pads from around the wicket
Tries to whack the length ball, gets it off the thick inside edge to long-on
Wide and full, Samson is able to free his arms and swing through. Gets it over long-off for a flat six
Long-hop slips out. It's pulled from outside off to long-on
Yorker on middle, Samson was winding up but had to jam it in front
Reverse pulls the googly spinning in towards middle. He had premeditated the shot and got it over backward point
Legbreak lands on leg stump, spins away and Samson tries to clip it. He's off balance as the leading edge takes the ball to the off side
Length on middle and off, punched to long-off
Thick outside edge from the bottom of the bat, off the cover drive, takes the overpitched ball to short third
Length outside off, beats the slog sweep and hits the pad of the keeper

Skier off the top edge, Narine settles underneath and shells it! Gurbaz was running towards him and that may have blocked the bowler's view. Narine tried taking it in front of his chest but the ball popped out in front. It was a length ball that Samson tried to hoick across the line
Pulls a length ball from fifth stump to long-on
Length ball straightens and comes in towards fourth stump. Cut to cover
Full outside off, driven to cover
Knuckle ball was worked to wide long-on
Outside edge beaten, Suyash closes his eyes and grimaces in disappointment. It was a length ball outside off that turned away, Samson tried to block it towards cover and missed it
Another googly on a length, flicked from fifth stump to long-on
Overthrow from point, he throws to the bowler's end but there's no catch or backing up. Was a back of length outside off that was cut.
Length outside off, cut to deep point

Half-tracker is slow and punished over midwicket for an 81-metre six. It was a googly that pitched around off and spun away but the slowness of the ball allowed the batter to shuffle across and whack it away
Punches it off a back of length outside off to deep cover
Length outside off, punched to cover
Full on fourth stump, pushed to long-off
Fullish ball on middle, flicked to long-on. Pace: 99kph
Charges while making room, gets to the pitch and gets it from leg stump over extra for an 80-metre six
Pulls the shortish ball from outside off to long-on
Length outside off, square driven to deep point
Back-foot flick is effortless, in the gap at midwicket and well to the right of long-on. A boundary aptly finishes the 78-run powerplay
Full at the stumps from around, pushed back to the bowler

Samson goes across and pulls, Rinku is at the deep-midwicket boundary, he jumps high but the 73-metre six clears him. He tried to palm the ball in from above his right shoulder. There were covers behind the cushions, his knee didn't land right and gets some medical attention
Length ball jags in and is punched off of middle and off to mid-off
Overpitched outside off, Samson stands still and tries to rock back with his upper-body and thump a cover drive. Gets it off the bottom of the bat to mid-off
Length outside off, spins away and dabbed to backward point
Slower ball on a full length follows Jaiswal as he makes room, drives to mid-off
Flat bats a length ball after making room, goes over mid-on for a one-bounce four. As Nick Knight notes, he's got 62 off the 68 total runs
Back of length just outside off, chopped behind point. It's in the gap again, Harshit brushes his hair as he walks back
Bumper rises well, Jaiswal shapes for the pull first and then tries to ramp it behind the keeper's head. Misses and then asks if it's a bouncer for the over, square-leg ump agrees
Length outside off, opens the face and dabs it towards deep third
Length ball angles in to middle, the 133kph ball to midwicket
Length just outside off, crunches a drive into the ground. Finds cover
Width offered, Jaiswal connects with a square drive. It races in the gap in front of point for four more
Cuts the length ball on fourth stump to backward point
Dabs it this time. Length outside off, goes to point
Beaten but Gurbaz goes 'never mind, come on.' Length outside off, Jaiswal tried to guide it off the back foot
Length ball down leg, tries to clip it but it's too wide
Switches his stance and tries the reverse, edges the length ball to short third
Length outside off, punched to point

Flicked to deep square leg to get to the fastest IPL fifty, second-fastest overall and Jaiswal flexes his muscles! It was on a length on the thigh pad. As soon as he hit it, he punched the air and ran the single. Smiles and applause erupt in the dugout
No, but he continues the book cricket, AR cricket as Harsha Bhogle says, EA cricket, as Raghav calls it to get another four through cover. It was a full ball that was slapped in the gap
Back of length just outside off, pulled through midwicket. It's in the gap again. Four more
Makes room and drives it against the inswing, gets to the pitch and middles it. Races along the ground to the extra-cover fence
Length outside off, dabbed to deep third
Hooks the shortish ball behind square to go to 37 off 9 balls

Another direct hit, this time at the striker's end, keeper's running in front but the deflection to the right beats him. It's right behind and no one's backing up at long stop. It was a length ball that was punched to mid-on. Rana there threw the ball, Jaiswal stepped aside and was in the crease and luck took over. Jaiswal gets four runs added to his score.

Direct hit from Russell finds Buttler short. Buttler took a step or two and put his gloves up to indicate he wanted to stop. Jaiswal was over halfway down the pitch for the run. Buttler went through but had no chance of making it with the direct hit. It was a back-of-length ball that came in to beat the back-foot defence, the ball hit the thigh pad and rolled towards cover point. It seemed like there was a run but a late start and hesitation cost Buttler.
Gurbaz dives to the left after a couple strides to save four. Another full ball pitches down leg and drifts further, past the flick
Back of length just outside off, angles in and is blocked towards cover
Back of length just outside off, dabbed off the back foot to deep third
Appeal for lbw is not given. Rana reckons there's an inside edge. Given leg-bye though. It was a length ball coming in, Buttler tried to block it straight. Ball went off the pad towards point
Full ball down leg, beats the flick and Gurbaz dives to the left to stop it
Short and wide, Jaiswal cuts it in the gap between point and backward point. 26 off the over, asking rate is down to 6.5
Fullish ball on leg is clipped to deep midwicket
Rana holds his action a bit but Jaiswal is in full flow. Cuts the shortish ball just outside off hard into the ground, gets it in the gap behind point
Down the track, gets it on the low full toss. Creams the cover drive, in the gap and along the ground. Wide of mid-off for four
Midwicket and long-on are back, so Jaiswal goes across, gets a length ball that angles in. It's down leg and all he has to do is connect with the sweep. Helps it behind square for a 69-metre six
No surprise from Jaiswal who dances down, not close to the pitch, but whacks it over long-on. Mid-on runs back but the ball sails 80 metres far for six
